1.why: All screens use a clean sans-serif typeface with comfortable element and line spacing, though the smaller evaluation-note text is denser than the rest.

2.why: Instructions are sentence case with no italics, and all-caps appears only in the base32 secret string and log output rather than in instructional text.

3.why: The flow is a single-column card with full-width buttons and large fields that scales to a narrow mobile viewport, though the captures show it on a wide desktop screen.

4.why: Steps 1–3 use one- to two-sentence plain instructions, while step 4 adds a longer, somewhat technical note referencing 'time-based TOTP codes (30-second windows)'.

5.why: The phone field shows a '+1 555 010 0184' placeholder and a mock code '037020' is displayed, but the email and six-digit authenticator fields show no example of expected input.

6.why: No screen requires reading a long passage to proceed; the longest block is the roughly four-line evaluation note on the authenticator setup step.

7.why: The secret JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP is rendered as selectable page text so copying is technically possible, but no copy button or similar affordance is provided.

8.why: No QR code or equivalent scan option appears on any screen; the authenticator secret is offered only as a manual text string.

9.why: The inputs are standard web fields, but nothing visible demonstrates autofill or password-manager support, and the page explicitly says 'Do not save it in this browser.'

10.why: Each screen is headed by the current step name ('Sign in to secure payments', 'Verify your identity', 'Set up your authenticator') with one dominant blue primary button beneath it.

11.why: Each step asks for a single main action, though the settings screen also presents a prominent red 'Sign out' button next to 'Set up authenticator'.

12.why: Successful transitions state what happened and what comes next (e.g., 'We sent a six-digit verification code...'), but the failure message 'Verification could not be completed.' gives no indication of next steps.

13.why: The rejected attempt leaves the form in place for retry, but there is no resend or re-request option and the secret 'is shown only for this enrolment step' with no reveal/hide control.

14.why: The only observed error, 'Verification could not be completed.', avoids blaming the user but states neither the cause of the problem nor how to fix it.

15.why: The verification code 'expires in five minutes' and authenticator codes run on '30-second windows', so explicit time limits on code entry are stated in the UI.
